scope: physical unsupported-hardware ABI fallback; no capable retention policy or speedup tested
checked_contract: Control modes0/1/2 return ENODEV on unsupported hardware.
Status returns ENODEV without modifying initialized sentinel before and after child.
Invalid mode/null status/nonzero spare arguments return EINVAL.
Child actually dropsuid/gid65534; all controls/status return EPERM with output unchanged.
Normal parent return, shell prompt, CORE/BSG PASS, runner_exit0.
acceptance_limits: Capability-present global readback/write/reset on new RTL remains pending.
This is a newkernel baseline and cannot price retention against historical kernel timing.
